gloss: food delivery; home delivery of food

definitions.explanation: the service of delivering prepared food from a restaurant to a customer's location

examples.japanese: {寿司|すし}の{出前|でまえ}を{頼|たの}む。
{出前|でまえ}は{無料|むりょう}ですか。
{雨|あめ}の{日|ひ}は{出前|でまえ}を{取|と}ることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: I often order delivery on rainy days.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{出前|でまえ}もやっていますか。
examples.english: Does this restaurant also do delivery?

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しいときは{出前|でまえ}で{済|す}ませることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: When I'm busy, I often just get delivery.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {出前|でまえ}を{頼|たの}む (to order delivery)
- {出前|でまえ}を{取|と}る (to get delivery)
- {出前|でまえ}をする (to do delivery - from restaurant's perspective)

RELATED WORDS:
- デリバリー (delivery - loanword)
- {宅配|たくはい} (home delivery - broader term)
- {配達|はいたつ} (delivery - general)
- {持|も}ち{帰|かえ}り (takeout)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional {出前|でまえ} in Japan often involves food being delivered on reusable dishes (like soba delivery), which are later collected. Modern delivery apps have made {出前|でまえ} more common, often using the term デリバリー.

{出前|でまえ}{一丁|いっちょう}! is a traditional call meaning 'One delivery coming up!'
